onboarding_created_body: You created a shared shopping list for everyone at home. Anything you add shows up for everyone in real time.
onboarding_invite_step_body: This code lets others join your household. Copy it or share it with a message — they'll paste it under "Join a household".
onboarding_share_step_title: Invite the people you live with
onboarding_share_step_body: Send the code to your partner, kids, roommate, or anyone who should see the list. They open Haserli, choose Join a household, and enter the code. You can always find the code again in Settings.
onboarding_join_body: You're in! You share the same shopping list with everyone in this home — add items, mark what's bought, and stay in sync.
onboarding_list_add_body: Tap this button to add anything to your list. Quick and easy.
onboarding_list_sync_body: Everything updates instantly for everyone in your household.
onboarding_list_settings_body: Manage members, invite code, and household name.
onboarding_list_extras_body: Tap here at the store — check off items as you shop!

tour.steps.hero.body: Quick picks based on what you buy often — tap one to add it to your list.

tour.steps.filters.body: Narrow the list to produce, dairy, cleaning, and more.

tour.steps.supermarketFab.body: At the store? Open this mode to check off items as you shop.
tour.steps.settings.title: Settings
tour.steps.settings.body: Manage your household, invite code, and account.
tour.steps.invite.title: Invite code
tour.steps.invite.body: Share this code so family or roommates can join your household.
tour.steps.activity.title: Activity feed
tour.steps.activity.body: See who added, bought, or removed items — everything in one timeline.
tour.steps.history.title: Purchase history
tour.steps.history.body: Everything you've bought, grouped by day. Tap an item to put it back on the list.
